decisions: Do not compare BTC/USDT directly as USD/BTC or silently assume USDT equals USD.
Do not average exchange prices into a synthetic quote.
Keep Kraken as the canonical price-source candidate; every captured trade remains review-only until all readiness and acceptance gates pass.
ETF flow remains blocked: Farside returned HTTP 403 from the runner and TFTC remains an unapproved mirror candidate with unresolved row timestamp/revision semantics.
DXY remains blocked until a specific accessible feed and observation-time convention are approved; third-party DXY reconstructions are not official ICE DXY.
Mempool hashrate and block-fees remain research-only; no fee/subsidy ratio is calculated or required for the first BTC scenario.
HTTP Date/Last-Modified/ETag/cache headers are preserved as response metadata, not treated as metric observed_at or proof of provider revision.
The candidate mapper now blocks a source event timestamp later than retrieval time; regression tests confirm HTTP headers do not populate source_updated_at.
No observations were ingested; no database, scenario state, monitoring state or probabilities were changed.
